description: For any first-order language and theory \(T\), if every existentially quantified finite conjunction of literals has a quantifier-free equivalent modulo \(T\), then every formula has such an equivalent.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.QuantifierElimination.qe_of_literal_conjunctions.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  (T : L.Theory)
  (h :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (row : List (L.BoundedFormula α (n + 1))),
      (∀ θ ∈ row, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderNormalForms.IsLiteral θ) →
        ∃ ψ, ψ.IsQF ∧ T.Iff (Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.QuantifierElimination.conjunction row).ex ψ)
  (n : ℕ) (φ : L.BoundedFormula α n) : ∃ ψ, ψ.IsQF ∧ T.Iff φ ψ
